title: GHOIT
tagline: The gateway to a world of secure and transparent transactions, connect, create, and make payment.
description:
This project uses GHO take to make payment by creating merchant, and invoices. This can be used on web2 platforms to make payment.
Some features of this project are: 
- Create merchant
- Send invoices
- Supply token on Aave
- Borrow GHO from Aave
- Repay
- Make Payment
- A CMS to track your invoices with invoices' status
how_its_made:
This project uses Aave protocol and GHO native token to make payment. This can interact with any eth-based wallet to make the payments.

For back-end side I used PHP to create RESTful API for creating merchant and invoices. I used Reactjs library for the front-end side.

MySQL is used for DB.
